lines.t: Before empires rose, before doctrines hardened, the Most High spoke, and the way was walked.
I stood at the gate where two roads divide
One loud with promise, one quiet with life
The crowd moved fast, their hands held high
But truth stood still and met my eyes
It didn't offer silver or a throne
It asked for my heart, my will, my bones
Leave what you were, come walk and see
Said the living word calling me
Not written on stone alone
But carved in a heart when the proud let go
Now here is the words for walkers made new
A covenant lived, faithful and true
I follow the footsteps in the dust
Where truth stays sharp and pride turns to rust
Not my way, not the voice of men
I walk the path He walked back then
Through fire refined
Through faith aligned
Breath of the Most High
Filling my lungs
I won't turn back
I won't delay
I walk the way
He touched the outcasts, spoke straight to kings
Called out the lie, wrapped in hollow things
He honored the Torah, fulfilled it in light
Lived every word, not one denied
No mask, no blend with the world's applause
He stood unmoved by the threat of loss
Servant's hands, yet authority clear
The kingdom drawn near, right here
repent means turn not feel regret change direction place your steps wide road path but the soul runs
dry narrow stays quiet but the truth stays alive commands ain't changed their life in motion
written within fueled by devotion not religion not culture not man-made flame set apart living
branded by name obedience ain't easy it cuts through the night follow the way stand up and
fight dust on your feet fire in your heart every small step is a brand new start turn from
Step into light, every breath living
Walk in his sight, no compromise
No half measures taken
Life's fully given when the king awakens
Strip me clean of borrowed names
Teach my feet your ancient ways
If it costs me all I've been
Let obedience be how I win
I follow the footsteps in the dust
Truth before comfort, obedience first
From dawn to dust, from breath to grave
I choose the life the Father gave
No turning back, no divided way
The narrow path is where I'll stay
Not tradition
Not the world
Only truth
Live
In Yahushua
Thank you for watching.
